name: facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/habitat_dataset_processing/habitat_dataset_processing/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.run_asset_pipeline: run the AssetPipeline to process Habitat datasets and output processed 3D assets to a directory
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.create_asset_database: create an AssetDatabase instance to register and track assets by their Habitat template names
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.register_asset_from_config: register an asset into the AssetDatabase by parsing its object or stage config JSON file
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.find_files_with_extension: find all files with a given extension recursively within a directory tree

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.process_models: batch process multiple 3D model jobs with optional multiprocessing support

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.run_decimate_meshes: run the magnum decimation tool to simplify 3D mesh triangles in an input scene file
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.run_decimate_quiet: run the decimation tool in quiet mode to suppress output logs during mesh processing
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.run_decimate_verbose: run the decimation tool in verbose mode to see detailed mesh simplification statistics
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.refactor_decimate_simplify: refactor the decimate function to adjust the simplify target error threshold for finer mesh detail
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.review_meshoptimizer_config: review the meshoptimizer configuration settings including simplifyTargetError and simplifyTargetIndexCountThreshold

facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.get_dependencies: recursively find all dependencies for a URDF, OBJ, MTL, or DAE asset file up to a given depth
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.resolve_relative_path: normalize a file path by removing dot and double-dot components without escaping the data folder
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.resolve_relative_path_with_wildcard: strip trailing wildcards and slashes from a path then resolve dot and double-dot components
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.is_file_collada: check whether a given file path has a COLLADA .dae extension
facebookresearch_habitat-lab/scripts/hab.get_dependencies_urdf: extract referenced asset file paths from a URDF file excluding Xacro macros
